subject: ready-for-life

location.unitTitle: Meal Planning, Cooking, and Food Management

instructions: Complete the task or its stated simulation alternative. Do not submit photos, recordings, addresses, account details, or private household information.
Learner completion never certifies a guardian-authority task; those tasks remain pending until a guardian attests.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain meal planning for variety and adequacy in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of shopping lists and unit costs.
Apply recipe scaling in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving knife heat and appliance safety; correct it and explain why.
Connect meal planning for variety and adequacy with cleanup and food-waste reduction. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: With guardian supervision, plan and complete a meal loop for more than one person or a detailed simulation.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy or fidelity criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated evidence and reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated application or performance criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated checking and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Meal Planning, Cooking, and Food Management?
